newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-SCA '96 profit seen 39 pct down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-SCA '96 profit seen 39 pct down.

text.p: Swedish forestry group SCA (Svenska Cellulosa AB) is expected to report a lower profit after financial items of 3.52 billion crowns for 1996 compared to 5.73 billion in 1995, a Reuter poll of 13 analysts showed on Monday.
Forecasts varied between 3.30 billion and 3.73 billion crowns. The average was 39 percent lower than profits a year ago.
Profit per share was expected to slip back to 10.60 crowns from 17.55 crowns in 1995.
SCA's board was expected to announce a dividend of around the same level as last year. The average of forecasts was for a dividend of 4.70 crowns compared to 4.75 crowns in 1995.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Carnegie, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Enskilda, Fiba, Fischer, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Paribas, Penser, Salomon Brothers, Swedbank, and Ohman.
SCA will release its earnings reports on January 30.
